text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, while talking with Mr. 
C.B. on the stair landing—

text_block_list.name: Frenzied Students
text_block_list.text:
I-I gotta hurry...! They're gonna sell 
out...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Oh, right! Today was the release 
date!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I heard that for a limited time, they're 
selling 'Wagyu Beef Curry Croquette Bread' 
at the school store.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to eat some too... Sigh, I guess 
there's no way today.
choice_data_list: Maybe we can still make it if we go now?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I just meant 'there's no way I 
could do it.' I mean, you'd have to wait 
in line, right? I'm not good with lines.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, I really do want to eat it... 
...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —That's it! There's still that option!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah. By the way, do you want some too, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello. It's me. Yeah. There are two 
things I need you to get through that 
channel of yours—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Alright, that's done. Shall we go then?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: To the meetup spot for our deal. Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —You made it. I've been waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey! Did you get that thing ready?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I haven't slipped up. ...Hey. Hand it over 
to them.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Entourage
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go. The real deal. Not a curry 
bun, not just some plain croquette bun. 
Heh heh heh...!

...Under an oddly unsettling atmosphere, 
the money and the savory bread in question 
were exchanged.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Thanks! You really saved me!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa. We haven't settled the bill 
yet, customer. I put myself in some 
dangerous spots to get my hands on that 
merchandise.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You didn't seriously think you could just 
pay for the bread and say goodbye, did 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then next time, I'll treat you to some 
delicious croquettes. A debt of croquettes 
is repaid in croquettes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Well, not bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh. This one is "hardcore," after 
all. I'm quite fond of it.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Putting on that refreshing face, yet 
always dragging everyone around just for 
the sake of her own selfish freedom.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Like the whole damn world exists just for 
you. Man, that really gets me fired up."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I like Sirius too. Because she's 
always honest.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —No. Not this time.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You paid off the last favor and the one 
before that with croquettes. I'm afraid 
their value has crashed.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"How about this: Why don't I toss a little 
pocket money to our folks who did the 
actual work?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If so... then will you entertain me? This 
self of mine?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Well then, what should I do...
choice_data_list: I'll whip Sirius's juniors into shape

How about running side-by-side with 
Sirius?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go with that! Is everyone else 
fine with that too?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, well isn't this some generous 
payment?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's an offer too good to refuse. Go 
accept it with all due respect, you lot.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Entourage
text_block_list.text: Ouss!!

And so—under Mr. C.B.'s guidance, thorough 
training was carried out.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds good! I'm in the mood for a 
run too!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well now, that turned out to be a 
sweet deal. Don't mind if I do, then.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Your passion, confidence, and pride in 
running. I'll take... every bit of it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's the spirit. Run a race true 
to yourself, just like Sirius should!

And the two engaged in a spectacular duel, 
like a sudden gust of wind.
